subject: workflow

capabilities.name: Durable execution via event log
capabilities.description: Every step invocation, hook, sleep and run transition is persisted as an append-only event; state is reconstructed by deterministic replay.

capabilities.name: Directive-based workflow/step split
capabilities.description: Files tagged with 'use workflow' (sandboxed VM) or 'use step' (full Node) are split by an SWC plugin into distinct bundles at build time.

capabilities.name: Sandboxed workflow VM
capabilities.description: Workflow orchestrator functions run inside node:vm with a restricted surface to keep them deterministic and replayable.

capabilities.name: FatalError / RetryableError
capabilities.description: Typed errors to opt steps out of retries (FatalError) or set custom retryAfter (RetryableError); default 3 retries per step.

capabilities.name: Parallel composition via Promise.all/race
capabilities.description: Standard JS async primitives (Promise.all, race, allSettled) work across durable steps — no special fan-out API.

capabilities.name: Hooks (external suspension points)
capabilities.description: Workflows can suspend awaiting external payloads (webhook/callback) and resume deterministically.

capabilities.name: Sleep primitive
capabilities.description: Durable sleep that survives process restarts; part of the event log.

capabilities.name: Pluggable storage 'worlds'
capabilities.description: Storage backends are abstracted via @workflow/world interfaces: local FS, Postgres (Drizzle), Vercel production, in-memory testing.

capabilities.name: Encryption at rest for payloads
capabilities.description: Event payloads can be encrypted client-side before persistence (CryptoKey-based).

capabilities.name: OpenTelemetry tracing
capabilities.description: Optional @opentelemetry/api peer dep; semantic conventions emitted for runs/steps.

capabilities.name: Standalone CLI mode
capabilities.description: Build and invoke workflows without a framework via `workflow` / `wf` CLI.

capabilities.name: Observability / UI hydration
capabilities.description: Core ships observability helpers (hydrateResourceIO) powering a replay/UI inspector.

unique_selling_points: Pure TypeScript async/await — no new DSL; Promise.all / race / sleep work durably
Event-sourced deterministic replay across cold starts / scale events
First-party integrations with the major Node.js meta-frameworks
Compiler-level split (SWC) between orchestrator sandbox and step Node runtime

limitations.description: Workflow functions run in a restricted node:vm — no direct Node.js API access inside orchestrator bodies.
Production-grade managed backend is @workflow/world-vercel; other backends (Postgres, local) target dev/self-host with less battle-testing.
Current npm channel is beta (5.0.0-beta.2); stable 4.x series coexists via dual branch model.
Core inputs/outputs must be serializable (devalue-compatible); non-serializable values break replay.
